New here? Start in three steps

CFOP is a four-step way to solve the cube: Cross, F2L, OLL, PLL. Pick where to begin:

This session: solve times (line) and Ao5 (dashed)

Your last 30 sessions: mean time per session

Where your time goes: Cross / F2L / OLL / PLL (last 12 solves)

All other code and icons in this app were written for this project. Cube algorithms are standard speedcubing notation.

Keyboard shortcuts

Timer (real cube)
SpaceHold until green, release to start. Any key or tap stops.
EscCancel the current attempt
Cube
U D R L F BTurn a face (Shift = prime)
Alt + letterWide move (r l u d f b)
M E S x y zSlices and whole-cube rotations
+ - 0Zoom in, zoom out, reset zoom
1–7Align view: Front, Back, Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Iso
NShow or hide the notation cube
Interface
HFocus mode (hide extras)
PShow or hide the side panel
?This panel
SpaceDigital mode: new scramble
